//: A counter is where you would get this if you were not making it at home — the kind of place a person recognises from their own street. A recipe can sit at several, because noodles are not only sold by the sushi-and-ramen place, so `counters` on a recipe is a list. `categories` here is a fallback only: a recipe that names no counter lands at whichever counters claim its category, so nothing is ever orphaned. The fallbacks are deliberately coarse — they exist so the build never drops a recipe, not because every brownie belongs at the same shelf — and they are meant to be replaced recipe by recipe with a `>> counters:` line. Counters with no fallback are filled in by hand; a counter with nothing on it simply does not render. The archetypes and the menu vocabulary behind them are recorded in docs/knowledge/counters.md.
